truth: Not reproduced here: the Madison Papers editors' decipherment of the passage (https://founders.archives.gov/documents/Madison/02-91-02-0526, note 2; it repeats the postscript of 9 Oct 1802, https://founders.archives.gov/documents/Madison/02-04-02-0007). The same words are interlined over the code on NARA T303 roll 2 frame 0320 in a contemporary hand.
caveat: The coded passage of 22 Oct 1802 turned out to be Eaton's repetition of his 9 Oct postscript (the edition says so in note 2). It is therefore not new text: its plaintext was already known to us from the 9 Oct edition. None of the postscript's group-to-word alignment went into the frozen key (key sources: Tunis letter body, Pinckney 1793, Lear 1813), and the numerals here were read blind from a third manuscript copy.
first_run_note: The first run returned 0 matched for the real and the shuffled keys alike: the truth text had been taken from the file header's explanation of the [[CIPHER> ... <CIPHER]] convention, which contains no letters. The extraction was corrected to the tagged passage and the measure re-run unchanged.
